_doc: Per-game RAM locations for the player's party. Hex strings: parse with Number(). GB/GBC/GBA entries come straight from pret .sym files (see 'sources', file:line). NDS entries are pointer chains: party = read_u32(saveDataPtrAddr) + partyMonsOffset. See research/live_ram.md for struct layouts and validation.

memory.note: Addresses are GB bus addresses. Offset into an emulator's WRAM array = addr - 0xC000 (for CGB 32 KiB WRAM this lands in bank 1, which is where the party lives).

sources.partyAddr: Ironmon-Tracker Feuerrote.json pstats; pokebot-gen3 (no D/F/I/S override of gPlayerParty)
sources.evidence: EWRAM (party, enemy party, battle structs, gMapHeader) is the same as in the US/European English ROM, IWRAM from gMain on lies 0xB0 lower (gMain 0x030030F0 → 0x03003040, gSaveBlock1Ptr 0x03005008 → 0x03004F58). Two independent tables agree: pokebot-gen3 modules/data/symbols/patches/language/pokefirered.yml + pokeleafgreen.yml (D/F/I/S override only the IWRAM symbols gMain, gSaveBlock1/2Ptr, gPokemonStoragePtr, gBattleMainFunc, gTasks, gBattleResults, gRngValue by -0xB0; gPlayerParty, gPlayerPartyCount, gEnemyParty, gBattleTypeFlags, gBattleMons, gBattlerPartyIndexes, gMapHeader keep the base pokefirered.sym/pokeleafgreen.sym address) and Ironmon-Tracker ironmon_tracker/GameAddresses/Pokemon Feuerrote/Rouge Feu/Rosso Fuoco/Rojo Fuego.json (pstats 0x02024284, estats 0x0202402C, gPlayerPartyCount 0x02024029, gBattleMons 0x02023BE4, gBattlerPartyIndexes 0x02023BCE, gBattleTypeFlags 0x02022B4C, gMapHeader 0x02036DFC; gSaveBlock1ptr 0x03004F58, gBattleMainFunc/gTasks/gBattleResults -0xB0; GameSettings.lua: 'IWRAM addresses are the same between all english versions of a game, and between all non-english versions'). LeafGreen = FireRed in both. Checked live in German FireRed and LeafGreen (scripts/rom-matrix/plans/firered-leafgreen-eu.json); the ROMs load gMain 0x03003040 581 times and gSaveBlock1Ptr 0x03004F58 452 times from their literal pools (0x030030F0/0x03005008 are the English game's).

games.verified: two independent trackers’ tables (pokebot-gen3, Ironmon-Tracker); checked in the running German games (BPRD, BPGD: party, battle HP, inBattle, gBattleTypeFlags, gMapHeader, gSaveBlock1Ptr – souldew 2.3.1 ROM matrix)

memory.note: Offset into a 4 MiB main-RAM dump = addr - 0x02000000. Pointers read from RAM are absolute (0x02xxxxxx); mask with 0x3FFFFF for an offset.

games.fallback: scan main RAM for PartyCore {u32 capacity=6; u32 count 1..6; mons[6]} and validate PK checksums (see live_ram.md)
games.saveDataPtrSource: pret/pokeheartgold xmap branch heartgoldus.xMAP line 57882: '02111868 0000001C .bss _02111868 (src_main.c.o)'; include/main.h + src/main.c: struct {mainOverlayId; overlayManager; queuedMainOverlayId; queuedMainOverlayTemplate; {unk_00; unk_04; SaveData *saveData}} -> saveData at +0x18. Cross-check: ROM arm9 word at 0x02000BA8 = 0x02111860 (NitroSDK module params, read from the user's HeartGold ROM) and NDS-Ironmon-Tracker uses *(0x02000BA8)+0x20.
games.partyOffsetsSource: SaveData.dynamic_region at +0x10 (pokeheartgold include/save.h:65-70) + General-block Party 0x98 / count 0x94 (PKHeX SAV4HGSS.cs:70-71, SAV4.cs:253 'General[Party - 4]'). NDS-Ironmon-Tracker playerBase = 0xA8.

legacyPointer.source: MKDasher, tasvideos.org/Forum/Topics/9485 (2014-01-06); offsets consistent with saveData = overlayManager + 0xCFE0 but only valid while the field app is running.

inBattle.verified: runtime-checked on Definitive HeartGold (IPKE) 2026-10-17: 0x2800 overworld, 0x2100 in a wild battle, back to 0x2800 after fleeing

games.verified: xMAP + ROM bytes (pointer); PKHeX (offsets); runtime not tested

badges.source: save general block in RAM (saveBase+0x10, same layout as the .sav: shared/gen4save.mjs)

battleActive.source: NDS-Ironmon-Tracker constants/MemoryAddresses.lua playerBattleMonPID (offset from *(*(0x02000BA8)+0x20), the saveData pointer) + BattleHandlerGen4.lua _getBattleMonPID (community). Field = BattleMon.personality of player battler 0: pokeheartgold include/battle/battle.h struct BattleMon has species at +0x00 and personality at +0x68 (checked against the struct layout); enemy battler 0 follows at +0xC0 (Ironmon enemyBattleMonPID 0x49F3C).
battleActive.validation: only trusted when the PID is one of the player's party PIDs (and the species at -0x68 matches); otherwise the HP-change heuristic applies

battleMons.fields: species u16 +0x00, moves 4×u16 +0x0C, level u8 +0x34, hp u32 +0x4C, maxHp u32 +0x50, personality u32 +0x68, status u32 +0x6C, otId u32 +0x74
battleMons.battlers: 0 player, 1 opponent, 2 player's second, 3 opponent's second (double battles)
battleMons.verified: live in DeSmuME, HeartGold US and Definitive HeartGold (IPKE), 2026-10-21: zeroed at battle start, filled when the mons are out, kept after the battle

inBattle.othersNote: any value but the battle values is no battle (NDS-Ironmon-Tracker BattleHandlerBase.lua treats it the same way); left to the heap copies, Bianca's catching demo showed as a battle against her Lillipup (#9)
